questions: Have you had these eye movements since birth or early childhood?
Do you feel dizzy, like the room is spinning around you?
Do you have ringing in your ears?
Do you have weakness in your arms or legs?
Do you have numbness or tingling on one side of your face or body?
Do you have difficulty speaking or swallowing?
Have you had any recent infections or fevers?
Do you have a history of multiple sclerosis, cancer, or stroke?
Do you take any medications regularly?
Do you have problems with your vision, such as blurred vision or vision loss?
Has anyone in your family had similar eye movements?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Idiopathic opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome (no identifiable structural, paraneoplastic, parainfectious, metabolic, or autoimmune cause on current work-up)
1. Paraneoplastic opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome with occult malignancy (consider FDG-PET/CT to detect an underlying tumour not visible on CT)
2. Autoimmune opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome associated with anti-GAD, anti-glycine receptor, or anti-Ri (ANNA-2) antibodies (paraneoplastic or non-paraneoplastic)
3. Rhombencephalitis or brainstem encephalitis (e.g., post-infectious or inflammatory) not yet visible on MRI
